ModZhkGrub.name: Acid Grub
ModZhkGrub.attack: Lunging bite that may coat the hero in acid
ModZhkGrub.special: Spit acid: the hero takes more damage a while
passive: Bite a hero in acid to grow tougher each time

ModZhkDrone.name: Brood Drone
ModZhkDrone.attack: Fire a stinger dart that may coat him in acid
ModZhkDrone.special: Dive through the hero, the sting coats him in acid
passive: Near death your dive hits hard, and kills you

ModZhkBeetle.name: Resin Beetle
ModZhkBeetle.attack: Snap that shoves the hero back
ModZhkBeetle.special: Spit resin: roots the hero, leaves a sticky puddle
passive: Shove him onto your resin and he sticks

ModZhkSpitter.name: Acid Spitter
ModZhkSpitter.attack: Slide an acid glob that bursts into an acid pool
ModZhkSpitter.special: Lay an egg that hatches a biting larva
passive: A hit on your full sac bursts it

ModZhkSoldier.name: Hive Soldier
ModZhkSoldier.special: Scythe Guard: strike whoever steps in, root
passive: Nobody came? Your next sweep is faster

ModZhkHornet.name: Hive Hornet
ModZhkHornet.attack: Fire a fan of acid stingers
ModZhkHornet.special: Mark the hero: all Zhekra near him swarm
passive: Marked, he leaves prints: Zhekra on them run fast

ModZhkSiphon.name: Blood Siphon
ModZhkSiphon.special: Dive onto the hero and stab him three times
passive: Each stab fills you. Killed full, you heal kin
ModZhkSiphon.vault: A drone grown to drink. Killed full of blood, it bursts and heals its kin

ModZhkNasute.name: Nasute
ModZhkNasute.attack: Squirt three glue specks, each may root the hero
ModZhkNasute.special: You and kin near you gain a plate
passive: Hit kin near you and you squirt the hero at once

ModZhkScarab.name: Amber Scarab
ModZhkScarab.attack: Bowl your ball at the hero
ModZhkScarab.special: Kick your ball over your head onto the hero
passive: Without your ball, you can only headbutt
ModZhkScarab.vault: Rolls a ball of resin and bowls or hurls it. Without its ball it is almost harmless

ModZhkMother.name: Brood Mother
ModZhkMother.attack: Acid drops fall round the hero
ModZhkMother.special: Frenzy: you and monsters near you speed up

ModZhkBloater.name: Acid Bloater
ModZhkBloater.attack: Blow a bubble that pops into acid drops
ModZhkBloater.special: Deflate: zip round the room, leaving acid
passive: After you zip you hang limp, then swell back
ModZhkBloater.vault: Floats on its own acid. It vents and zips round the room, then hangs limp

ModZhkMantis.name: Acid Mantis
ModZhkMantis.special: Open your blades, then snap them shut in an X
passive: You cut anything close by, shots too

ModZhkAntlion.name: Pit Antlion
ModZhkAntlion.attack: Jaw clamp that may make the hero bleed
ModZhkAntlion.special: Dig a wide pit: slow out, quick in
passive: In the pit you flick sand: it knocks him inward
ModZhkAntlion.vault: Sits at the bottom of a sliding sand pit and flicks back whatever climbs

ModZhkHive.name: Amber Hive
ModZhkHive.attack: Comb slam: drop your weight on the hero
ModZhkHive.special: Send two slow hornet swarms that sting and Mark
passive: His hits spill your amber: in resin you heal

ModZhkHunter.name: Hunting Wasp
ModZhkHunter.attack: Long lance sting that may daze the hero
ModZhkHunter.special: Rise, circle, Mark the hero, then fly faster
passive: Lance a Marked hero to carry him into the swarm
ModZhkHunter.vault: A blue spider wasp. It stings marked prey and carries it off to the swarm

ModZhkGorger.name: Blood Gorger
ModZhkGorger.attack: Drill that may bleed. Each hit stores blood
ModZhkGorger.special: Pump blood into kin to heal them
passive: A full sac takes more damage and spills on a hit
ModZhkGorger.vault: A sac of stolen blood on stilt legs. It pumps the blood into its kin

ModZhkBotfly.name: Botfly Matron
passive: Implanted, every hit he takes hatches a larva
ModZhkBotfly.vault: Lays its egg in the hero. Every blow he takes while it is in him hatches a larva

ModZhkColossus.name: Chitin Colossus
ModZhkColossus.attack: Horn gore that throws the hero back

ModZhkMortar.name: Glue Mortar
ModZhkMortar.attack: Lob a glue shell on the hero. It slows, leaves glue
ModZhkMortar.special: Lob shells at the hero and the kin near him
passive: No kin near him: one shell, slower lobs
ModZhkMortar.vault: Its head is a barrel. It shells the hero through its kin, who spot for it

ModZhkStag.name: Stag Titan
ModZhkStag.attack: Pinch at the jaw tips, at reach
ModZhkStag.special: Hook the hero at your tips and toss him up
passive: Up close you can only headbutt
ModZhkStag.vault: Antler jaws longer than its body. They toss the hero up, but can't reach in close

ModZhkSunScarab.name: Sun Scarab
ModZhkSunScarab.attack: Shove your ball into the hero, big knockback
ModZhkSunScarab.special: Release the ball at him: it cracks on impact
passive: Your ball picks up larvae. They jump out at him
ModZhkSunScarab.vault: Rolls a glowing ball of amber with larvae caught inside, and lets them out on the hero

ModZhkLarva.name: Hive Larva
passive: Near the Brood Mother you don't wither

ModZhkGrubling.name: Royal Grub
ModZhkGrubling.attack: Lunging bite that may coat the hero in acid
ModZhkGrubling.passive: A larva the Brood Mother fed royal jelly
ModZhkGrubling.vault: A larva the Brood Mother fed on royal jelly until it grew into an Acid Grub
